newsitem.title: UK: IBCA rates Greece's Euromerchant Bank individual B.
newsitem.headline: IBCA rates Greece's Euromerchant Bank individual B.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency said on Tuesday it had assigned individual and legal ratings of B and 4 respectively to Euromerchant Bank, the third largest private sector bank in Greece and the sixth largest commercial bank.
Euromerchant Bank is a member of a European banking group, owned by the Latsis family, which also has banking operations in London, Geneva, Monaco, Luxembourg and Guernsey, IBCA said in a statement.
"Since its inception, primarily as a wholesale bank, its profitability has compared well with international peers," IBCA said.

"Its small commercial loan portfolio has remained of good quality and liquidity and capital are strong. The bank is one of the few Greek banks with any significant investment banking capability and it is continuing its controlled expansion into the higher end of the Greek retail market," IBCA said.

"These strengths are reflected in IBCA's individual rating. The legal rating reflects the agency's opinion that the bank is likely to receive support, in case of need, either from within the banking group (or from the Latsis family) or from official sources wishing to maintain confidence in the Greek banking system; while likely, such support is not certain," IBCA said.
